towns.name: Mayoi
towns.summary: Mayoi (61.6S 81.9E) is the quiet Sho town 'nestled in the base of the Tou peninsula', where weary Sho come to meditate by the bay while calm waves roll onto the sand; Shoyanen Kenchu's spire stands to the south-east and rumour puts a portal to the Vesayen Isles on the beach (Town Network sign). It was once overrun by a Diamond Golem Suzerain and later T'Thuun's Marauders, and is home to Bowyer Tentou, Tonsho's Remedies, the Ten Ox House and Zhen's Tower. In the DAT it is a terrace town at z 28 in LBs 0xE532/0xE632: two rows of Sho halls (spire-roofed and octagonal pagoda halls in green and dark timber) flank a southern street and a northern lane around a wooded hollow, lantern posts line both, the Town Network portal glows on its blue stone pad beside the Nullified Statue of a Golem on its pedestal, and the three-storey octagonal pagoda of Zhen's Tower (31 m) stands on the eastern bluff above a palm-fringed beach and the bay (sea from x~44330), where a Moarsman fortress squats in the shallows.
